answer: Use a postal registry: each agent links one device to one address and receives an onyx card by mail. First, it registers its device fingerprint and address. Second, a code arrives in 5-10 days, due within 14 days. Third, one address hosts at most two agents; duplicates face manual review. Forging 10,000 identities needs 5,000 real addresses and $150,000 in postage, while the mailed code is a signal no bot farm can fake at scale, and trust hits its nadir for mass fakes needing real mailboxes. Like a lock opened only by a key left at your door, it anchors identity to a real place.
